caseName: Daniels & Kennedy, Inc. v. A/S Inger
caseNameFull: Daniels & Kennedy, Inc. v. A/S Inger
attorneys: Joseph M. Soviero and Harold Klein for petitioner. Warner Pyne and William A. Wilson for respondent. Martin J. McHugh and James M. Leonard for the National Association of Stevedores, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Motion of the National Association of Stevedores for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.
